document_summary: Adopted Jersey City, NJ Ordinance 25-057 adding § 218-12 to Chapter 218, banning landlords from using third-party service providers that coordinate nonpublic competitor rental information (algorithmic rent-fixing).

rules.title: Preventing Algorithmic Rent-Fixing in the Rental Housing Market (Ord. 25-057, § 218-12)
rules.requirement: Real estate lessors, their agents and subcontractors may not subscribe to, contract with, or pay a service provider that coordinates nonpublic competitor rental information; service providers may not facilitate agreements not to compete among lessors on rental pricing, fees or other terms.
rules.key_value: Ban on contracting with algorithmic rent-setting service providers
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to real estate lessors of residential dwelling units (primary residences) in Jersey City; 'nonpublic competitor information' is less than 365 days old and not widely and readily available to the public at no cost.
rules.exemptions: Owners of multiple properties for actions related exclusively to properties controlled by the same owner; licensed real estate agents operating in accordance with state regulations; residential dwelling units exclude inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.
rules.interaction: New Jersey's FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) may preempt this ordinance once it takes effect; not addressed in this document.
rules.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise
exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
rules.conflict_note: Possible preemption by New Jersey's FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) once effective. This document does not mention the FAIR Act or its effective date.
rules.extraction_notes: Month of adoption; exact effective date not stated in source (NJ ordinances generally take effect after final passage and publication). Adopted on second and final reading May 21 2025; mayor approved May 22 2025. Ordinance text is internally inconsistent in section naming (Chapter 218 titled 'Multiple Dwellings' vs 'Fees and Charges'); penalties not extracted.
